summary: Backend-only testing for Dukkank store: notify-requests, cart events, admin analytics, subscription bundleDiscountPct migration + persistence, and regression on existing endpoints. 22/22 new tests passed + 20/20 prior regression tests still pass. Admin password preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1036 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, admin, public, analytics) once it exceeds ~1200. Not urgent.
POST /api/events/cart-add is fully public with no rate limiting — could be abused to inflate analytics. Consider IP-based throttling or auth requirement for production.
GET /api/admin/analytics fetches ALL cart_events / subscribers via async cursor (no $match index hints). Add index on cart_events.ts and subscribers.created_at for scale.
NotifyRequestPayload has no length cap on gameId/contact/name — recommend Pydantic Field(max_length=...) to prevent abuse.
Analytics caps days to 90 but timeline always returns dense day list — fine for now, but expensive for very large ranges if scope grows.
POST /api/notify-requests does not validate phone/email format — only checks non-empty. Optional improvement: regex/email validator if business requires it.
test_credentials: admin@dukkank.com / omar512@@OoD (verified still working at end of test run)
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed notify_requests and cart_events. A few TEST_ cart_events remain by design (cart_events has no delete endpoint) — they are harmless analytics rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new endpoints (POST /api/notify-requests, GET+DELETE /api/admin/notify-requests, POST /api/events/cart-add, GET /api/admin/analytics) verified end-to-end including auth gates, dedupe, 400/401/404 paths, sorting (desc by created_at), 7/30-day timeline shape, and audit log integration. Subscription.bundleDiscountPct migration is present on all durations and round-trips via PUT /api/admin/subscriptions/{id}. Admin password preserved. test_notify_analytics_bundle.py is idempotent and can be re-run safely.
rca of the issue: No issues found — all 22 new tests + 20 prior regression tests pass.
